scope: Git-only fixed-source CURRENT lock hypothesis and diagnostic-patch static review

findings.hypothesis: A live broker retains a lifetime-exclusive CURRENT flock, so Initial fixture head() necessarily fails when it opens a second owner.
findings.conclusion: Not supported by original implementation; the proposed lifetime-lock common cause is excluded.
evidence: RootAuthorityDirectory retains a directory File and ownership metadata, not an AuthorityFileLock.
HostAuthorityFrontierStore retains root/name/frontier durability state, not an AuthorityFileLock.
open_bounded, AuthorityFrontierStore::load and compare_and_set each acquire a local publication_lock guard; its Drop unlocks on return in the acquiring process.
A concurrent short critical section may still return Conflict. This review does not claim absence of all possible contention.

findings.hypothesis: The two failed tests both reopen CURRENT from their STABLE callback.
findings.conclusion: False for the fixed publication fixture.
evidence: Initial fixture head() calls NeuronGenerationCurrentOwnerV1::open and original_broker_head().
Publication fixture's STABLE callback reads protected_files(current_path) and authority.claims. It does not open another CURRENT owner; its journal setup uses the existing Arc current.

findings.hypothesis: The frontier-store flock failure propagates the raw os error 11 seen in the old log.
findings.conclusion: Not directly; this path maps the error.
evidence: RootAuthorityDirectory::lock maps nonblocking flock failure to AuthorityTrustError::Conflict.
AuthorityTrustError Display prints the enum variant.
CurrentStore open/load maps it through invalid(), which constructs AgentdError::Invalid(error.to_string()).
A different underlying error could still have been masked by a later raw control recv error in the old fixture. The original failure source therefore remains unknown.

findings.conclusion: No confirmed static compilation or lifecycle blocker found in this reread.
evidence: All four fixed-commit contents match their reviewed postimage Git blobs.
Both Initial and publication parent modules import std::io::Seek for the shared helper's rewind calls.
Stdio::from(File) consumes duplicated anonymous output descriptors while ChildOwner retains original File handles; no new capabilities are handed to the child beyond its stdout/stderr descriptors.
Existing child argv, uid/gid, inherited socket/executable FDs, stdin release, alarm/deadline and kill/wait cleanup ordering remain.
Drop prints wait's Result. If wait fails, emitted bytes are a snapshot and do not prove termination.
Context wraps existing results and preserves negative typed-error checks; expected refused-frame service outcomes are not newly required to succeed.

new_run_observation: Root controls the admitted V3 run and status reconciliation. This review makes no V3 execution or completion claim.
recommendation: Keep the original locking and all assertions unchanged. Diagnose the first actual child/service failure from the new fixed-source logs; preserve failed-attempt attribution.
